data.title: Are Unitree's humanoid robots worth the hype, or do investors just want in on the sector?
data.description: Hao Hong of Lotus Asset Management says the extreme 8,000x oversubscription in Unitree Robotics reflects a lack of quality investment opportunities in China’s high-tech manufacturing sector. He noted that current humanoid robot models are mostly used for amusement rather than performing real work – comparing them to robotic arms, which have seen widespread deployment in Chinese factories.
